author: Duncan Thorburn
content: You have got to be twelve, God help the world when you grow up. After Hitler we don't need another evil genius. But strangely, I like you, I even went all the way to Pluto with you. The music theory I go on about, I bet you could do in an afternoon, to code it. Some music is at www.myspace.com/duncanglennthorburn hope you like this little spec in the universe.
